title: The Game of Packages Italy: Stefano De Martino & €300K Prize 2025/26
text:
The popular Italian game demonstrate Affari Tuoi , known internationally as “Deal or No Deal,” returned to screens on April 1, 2026, with a new episode featuring host Stefano De Martino. The program, a staple of Italian television, pits contestants from across the country against each other – and against the infamous “Dottore” – in a high-stakes game of chance for a potential prize of €300,000. This particular episode, part of the 2025/26 season, saw 20 participants representing different regions of Italy vying for the substantial sum.
Affari Tuoi ’s enduring appeal lies in its simple yet compelling premise. Contestants select from a series of sealed briefcases, each containing a different monetary amount. Throughout the game, they receive offers from the “Dottore” – a character known for his shrewd negotiating tactics – to sell their briefcase. The tension builds as contestants weigh the potential value of their case against the risk of losing a larger sum. The show’s format encourages strategic thinking and emotional investment from both participants and viewers.
This episode, lasting 53 minutes, followed the standard Affari Tuoi structure. A contestant, selected at random, partners with a fellow participant to navigate the game. The duo must decide whether to accept offers from the Dottore or continue opening briefcases, hoping to reveal higher values and ultimately secure the top prize. The regional representation adds another layer to the competition, fostering a sense of local pride and rivalry among the contestants. The show consistently draws a large audience, becoming a cultural touchstone in Italy.
The Game of the Briefcases: How Affari Tuoi Works For those unfamiliar with the format, Affari Tuoi , which translates to “Your Business,” centers around a game of information and risk assessment. Twenty briefcases are arranged before the contestant, each containing a sum ranging from €0.01 to €300,000. The contestant chooses one briefcase to keep, and then proceeds to open the others, revealing the amounts inside.
After each revealed amount, the Dottore – played by a rotating cast of personalities – makes an offer to buy the contestant’s briefcase. The offer is based on the average value of the remaining unopened cases. The contestant must then decide whether to accept the offer, effectively cashing out, or reject it and continue opening briefcases, hoping for a higher payout. The game continues until only two briefcases remain: the contestant’s and the Dottore’s. At this point, the Dottore makes a final offer, and the contestant must decide whether to accept it or risk everything on the contents of their chosen briefcase.
Stefano De Martino’s Role as Host Stefano De Martino has become synonymous with Affari Tuoi , having hosted the show since its revival in 2017. RaiPlay , the streaming platform for the Italian public broadcaster RAI, highlights his engaging presence and ability to connect with both the contestants and the audience. De Martino’s role extends beyond simply announcing the rules and managing the game flow; he actively participates in building suspense and eliciting emotional responses from the players. His interviewing style often delves into the contestants’ personal stories, adding a human element to the competition.
De Martino’s background includes experience as a dancer and choreographer, skills that translate well to the dynamic energy of the show. He’s also a familiar face on Italian television, having appeared in various other programs, which contributes to his widespread appeal and the show’s continued success.
The “Dottore” and the Art of Negotiation The “Dottore” is arguably the most iconic element of Affari Tuoi . This character, portrayed by different actors over the years, embodies a cold, calculating approach to negotiation. The Dottore’s offers are rarely generous, and his primary goal is to acquire the contestant’s briefcase for the lowest possible price.
The Dottore’s tactics often involve psychological manipulation, attempting to exploit the contestant’s fears and uncertainties. He might highlight the low values revealed in previous rounds or emphasize the risk of losing a substantial amount of money. The interplay between the contestant and the Dottore is a key source of drama and entertainment on the show. The Dottore’s identity for the April 1, 2026 episode has not been publicly released.
Looking Ahead: Future Episodes and Continued Popularity Affari Tuoi continues to be a ratings winner for RAI, and the show is expected to remain a fixture on Italian television for the foreseeable future. The format’s simplicity, combined with the element of chance and the engaging personalities of the host and the Dottore, ensures its enduring appeal. Future episodes will likely continue to feature contestants from diverse backgrounds and regions of Italy, offering a snapshot of the country’s cultural landscape.
The next scheduled broadcast of Affari Tuoi is confirmed for April 8, 2026, on RAI 1. Viewers can also catch up on past episodes and find additional content on the RaiPlay streaming platform. The show’s official social media channels provide updates on upcoming episodes and behind-the-scenes content.
